newsitem.headline: European Diary for Advertising & Media to July 6.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - to
July 6, 1997
The following is a four-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe.
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 11

LONDON - "Who Are These Guys?" Account Planning Group seminar on who are the management consultants, what is their agenda, and how should advertising agencies respond. Barbican Centre, London. Contact: (44) 181 444 3692
